cases.original_forecast: An open-boundary dose can lose carbon before sealing; a closed dose retains its carbon budget. Final states need not agree even with identical nominal additions.

criteria.criterion: Account explicitly for carbon transferred out before the first vessel was sealed.
Sealing must not restore previously lost carbon.

limitations: Boundary-budget demonstration only: open-dose equilibrium and subsequent explicit reservoir update, not calibrated60s mass-transfer or degassing kinetics. Actual clocks differ120s/60s; no equal-aged rate comparison. No lost carbon is restored by sealing, apart from explicitly added baseline air.

cases.original_forecast: The model’s ferromagnetic solid operation should collect metallic iron, not remove dissolved Fe(III) merely because the element is iron.

criteria.criterion: Compare metallic and dissolved iron transfer independently.
A magnetic susceptibility concept must not be confused with bulk extraction of all iron ions.

limitations: Selectivity of explicit magnetic-solid operation on the actual metallic/dissolved inputs only. Ordinary bulk extraction is distinguished from nonzero ionic susceptibility. Slow metal corrosion and unoffered metastable iron-oxide/hydroxide formation remain unpredicted; no stable-phase precipitation or long-term corrosion claim.

cases.original_forecast: If enzyme and substrate transfer proportionally, both portions retain the same concentrations and should show similar fractional peroxide depletion, while absolute consumption scales with volume.

criteria.criterion: Verify proportional enzyme and substrate transfer before comparing rates.
Compare fractional loss from each post-split starting amount, not equal absolute gas amounts.

limitations: Proportional enzyme/substrate transfer is proven, but99.999999% substrate was consumed before the split. Equalzero subsequent losses cannot establish matching nonzero fractional kinetics. Registry C is a surrogate amount tracer, not a240kDa protein formula; no invented full molecular atom closure is claimed. Other declared molecules close separately.
